implementation_findings: The extracted helper performs exactly the prior reversible whole-receipt probe. Failed fit restores validation_work and the previous details_omitted value, including true/false/null or key absence.

The existing body-eviction loop continues to use the same helper. Failed early probes preserve the normal fallback order. Missing validation_work is not converted to zero or completeness.

measure includes the omission marker, packing ledger, byte count and token estimate. No cap, ranking weights, candidate order, source proof, original boundary expectation or original oracle was changed.

Existing controls cover failed rollback and late body preservation.
